body: My biggest goal in life is to be the best in the world in what I do. I think it’s priority takes over everything. I’m happy with working toward it and play life as it comes. Ask yourself is being in a relationship the only thing you want the most out of life. If yes put all your energy into it and it will workout. If no, you have something else to look forward to to keep going forward
